source(output(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: '[Invoice].[Pr_GenerateXML_MAInv_PSD] 	@BatchId = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSRCTCXML	source(output(
		COUNT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CAST(TOTALRECCOUNT AS INT)  AS COUNT FROM [BOSS].[INVOICE].[TCFILETRAILER] WHERE BATCHID= ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBPSDCNT
OLEDBSRCTCXML derive({Copy of COL_XML} = toString(COL_XML)) ~> DCTCXML
SRCOLEDBPSDCNT sink(input(
		COUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		COUNT)) ~> DSTFFPSDCNT
DCTCXML sink(input(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		COL_XML = {Copy of COL_XML})) ~> FFDSTTCXML
